astra.failure_policy: clear active intervention; fresh native conditioning until the next scheduled decision
astra.hold: Accepted choices are reapplied to fresh observations at every 5-action replan until the next scheduled decision; no asynchronous responses.

feedback.current: Up to4 recent raw paired observations, proprioception, original task, own2 previous decisions, and labeled training-donor contact sheets.
feedback.previous_rollout: Own latest completed rollout's4 raw paired snapshots and binary benchmark outcome; first revision receives shared baseline. No cross-arm feedback.

learning.claim: Assisted correction study, not autonomous learned improvement.

noise: Fresh native full-dimensional Gaussian per replan; identical keyed stream across all arms at the same episode/revision/step. Revision0 is the shared native baseline. Revisions1,2 use new matched streams, including native_retry.

representations.pixel_blend: Round-to-nearest uint8 convex blend of current raw pixels and the same verified donor pair before native vision encoding.
representations.random_controls: At each25-action decision, sample uniformly from the same donor/source catalogs and alpha uniformly on [0,1]; distinct A/B text sources. Independent intervention RNG, same policy noise as Astra. Astra may also explicitly defer to native; random controls do not model its deferral distribution.
representations.tei: Existing instruction-token interpolation: (1-alpha)E_A+alpha E_B; alpha0 selects A, alpha1 selects B.
representations.tli: Existing instruction-token residual after blocks0..16: h += (1-2alpha)(T_A-T_B); alpha0.5 is zero. Nine frozen demonstration-mean text banks remain unchanged.
representations.tli_vli: Disjoint text residual and visual convex interventions in the same prefix forward, with independent language and vision coefficients.
representations.vei: For both observed cameras, convex interpolation of current post-projector image-prefix tokens toward the same-grid tokens of one verified paired training frame; alpha0 is native.
representations.vision_bank_prompt: Current original target instruction; donor task prompt is metadata only. No donor proprioception is imported.
representations.vision_library: Existing45 fixed paired training frames from nine standard LIBERO tasks; no OOD demonstrations.
representations.vli: For both observed cameras, convex interpolation of current post-block visual slots toward the corresponding slots of one verified paired training frame at blocks0..16; alpha0 is native. No direct writes to text slots.

scope: Exploratory follow-up on all20 known OOD compositions with a new seed47/reset0; not held-out-task generalization or a paper pi0 replication. Historical studies use different settings and are not pooled.
stopping: Stop an arm after first benchmark success or2 intervention revisions. A successful shared baseline needs no intervention. Development additionally executes one revision for implementation coverage, explicitly excluded from success gains.

video.source: Unmodified policy external-camera frame before every executed action; recording excludes inference pauses and the terminal post-action frame.
